lines.en: I venture into the worst part of town to hang out with a girl who's way too good for me and find her eating dinner in the dining section of the convenience store.
lines.zh: 我闯进城中最糟糕的那片区域，去和一个我远远配不上的女孩待在一起，结果撞见她正在便利店的用餐区吃晚饭。

lines.en: I question whether or not it's okay for her to do this seeing as she's the only person who's ever working, but then I remember just how infrequently people come in here and stop caring.
lines.zh: 我一度怀疑她这么做合不合适——毕竟她是这里唯一一个在打工的人——但随即想起这儿的客人稀少到什么程度，也就不在意了。

lines.en: After all, if I can go my entire life without working, I shouldn't fault Noriko for following my footsteps just because she knows better.
lines.zh: 毕竟，如果我都能一辈子不工作，那我也不该因为 Noriko 明明比我懂事、却偏偏学我的样子而责怪她。

lines.en: She makes room for me at the table and I pull up a chair so I can drown my infinite numbness in the ecstasy my sheer existence provides her.
lines.zh: 她在桌边给我腾出位置，我拉过一把椅子坐下，好把我那无尽的麻木淹没在——仅仅是我的存在就能给她的狂喜之中。

lines.en: And while she likely spends the next two hours waiting for me to make out with her, I spend the next two hours looking at her as a sister.
lines.zh: 而她大概会用接下来两个小时等我和她亲热，我却用这两个小时把她当妹妹看待。

lines.en: I imagine that's just a side effect of having viewed her that way in what I can only imagine as the better half of my life at this point.
lines.zh: 我想，这只是因为我曾经那样看过她——在我至今为止人生中，我只能姑且称之为「比较好的那一半」的时光里。

lines.en: Though, it's likely that's not the case at all as this is apparently my second seemingly permanent bout of childish sorrow.
lines.zh: 不过，事实大概并非如此，因为这显然已经是我第二段看似永久的幼稚悲伤了。

lines.en: But that's just the thing. It's only {i}seemingly{/i} permanent. And what better way to question permanence than by expelling my energy on the rival of the one I lost?
lines.zh: 可问题就在于此。它只是「{i}看似{/i}」永久。而要质疑永恒，还有什么比把精力倾泻在我失去的那个人的对手身上更好的办法？

lines.en: I hope she's looking down on or up at me from wherever she is or isn't and that the jealousy this would cause her forces her back into existence.
lines.zh: 我希望她正从她所在或不在的地方俯视或仰视着我，希望这份嫉妒能把她逼回现实。

lines.en: But of course it doesn't. And the girl who's too good for me continues to be tainted by my presence up to the moment I go home to one I deserve.
lines.zh: 但当然没有。而那个我配不上的女孩，继续被我的存在所玷污，直到我回到家、回到那个我配得上的人身边。
